text:
jen: Sev2 in prod — token-service returning 500s for short-lived keys. Patch ready (v2.3.8-hotfix). Need expedited deploy, canary or skip?
deploybot: Deploy request received for tag v2.3.8-hotfix. Default plan: canary 10% eu-west1 for 15m. To skip canary, request requires approvals from SRE + Eng oncall + Product/ops.
sam: What caused the 500s? If it's config-only we can flip quickly, but code patch needed looks safe.
mikel: From logs it's a race in cache warmup, patch fixes ordering. Rollback is clean (revert to v2.3.7).
jen: Rollback command: `deploybot rollback v2.3.7`. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/token-service (check step 2/alert channels).
priya: Product +1 to expedite. Customer impact in payments flow, need asap. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: I can grant ops ack. We still need one SRE signoff for skip.
mikel: +1 SRE — I can take watch and respond. Approve skip-canary. :eyes:
sam: +1 Eng oncall. If we skip canary, hold EU traffic routing until we confirm token issuance rate is back to normal.
deploybot: Approvals recorded: ops-oncall, mikel, sam. Initiating fastlane override: executing `deploybot deploy --tag v2.3.8-hotfix --skip-canary --notify-on-failure`.
deploybot: Rolling out to 100% (canary bypass). Hosts: 12 -> 12, rolling - streaming logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/5489
jen: Running synthetics against token endpoints now — pinging internal checkers. Watch metrics: error rate, latency P95, token issuance throughput.
priya: I'll prepare a short release blurb for customers and post incident notice if any degrade: draft -> https://docs.redwood/release-notes/drafts/1738004321
mikel: Monitoring hooks set, escalation if errors >3% for 5m. I'll be on pager for the next 45m.
deploybot: Deploy finished: v2.3.8-hotfix active on all hosts. No elevated errors in first 6m. To rollback: `deploybot rollback v2.3.7` (manual).
jen: Thanks team. We'll keep thread open for 30m while we confirm stability, then close and add to release notes + postmortem if needed. :rocket:
